title: GodotForge CreatorManifest v2 (internal contract)
description: Deterministic, offline, AI-free manifest for PATCH-0016 (Behavior v2 & Parameterized Controller). No LLM, network, telemetry, or generated source is used. Behavior identity and version come from the registry/template only; this schema has no behavior name/version fields (single version authority).

schema_version.description: Schema version — must be 2 for PATCH-0016.

name.description: Game name — validated no CR/LF/NUL, used for project.godot config/name.

input.description: Exactly three inputs — move_left, move_right, jump — each once, fixed bindings.

binding.description: Fixed binding per name (enforced in godotforge_core/creator/manifest.py): move_left→ui_left, move_right→ui_right, jump→ui_accept.

parameters.description: Optional behavior parameters; omitted means all canonical defaults.

platformer_controller.description: v2 platformer controller parameters. Gravity is fixed at 980.0 and is NOT a parameter (unknown key).

speed.description: Horizontal move speed (px/s), inclusive range 50.0..500.0, default 200.0. Canonical numeric rules in creator/numfmt.py: max 6 significant digits, no NaN/inf/negative-zero.

jump_velocity.description: Jump velocity (negative = upward), inclusive range -1000.0..-100.0, default -350.0. Same canonical numeric rules as speed.

creator_fixed_bindings_note: Fixed bindings (enforced in godotforge_core/creator/manifest.py, not in JSON Schema alone): move_left→ui_left, move_right→ui_right, jump→ui_accept. Exactly one of each, no duplicates/omissions/unknown names. manifest.py remains authoritative; this schema is validated against it by tests/unit/test_creator_manifest_schema_v2.py.
